svg.title: Uno R3 Two-Cell Battery Measurement Divider

g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: J1 positive -> R1 39 kohm -> A0 tap -> R2 12 kohm -> J1 negative/GND. This divider scales 8.4 V to about 1.98 V at A0.

g.desc: J1 positive -> R1 39 kohm -> A0 tap -> R2 12 kohm -> J1 negative/GND. This divider scales 8.4 V to about 1.98 V at A0.

g.text: The reference input is a protected two-cell lithium-ion pack. Do not connect battery positive directly to the Uno. Verify the pack, resistor rating and maximum voltage. The Uno is USB powered. ADC voltage estimate and battery protection are not validated by this drawing.
